newsitem.title: USA: FP&L St Lucie nuke returns to full power.
newsitem.headline: FP&L St Lucie nuke returns to full power.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co's 839 megawatt (MW) St Lucie 1 nuclear power unit was operating at full power as of early Monday following a repair shutdown last week, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, located in Hutchinson Island, Fla., was operating at 100 percent of capacity, the NRC said in its daily plant status report for Monday.
St Lucie 1 was shut March 4 due to a faulty circuit breaker, but had moved into a restart mode as of last Friday.
The adjacent 839 MW St Lucie nuclear unit 2 was operating at full power as of early Monday, the NRC said.
FP&L is a subsidiary of FPL Group Inc.
